svg.title: DocsForge, Production
svg.desc: Open-source MCP server for official, version-specific docs. How it works: library name → find docs → verify → harvest → MCP tools. Name a library and DocsForge finds its official documentation, verifies it, harvests it and serves it to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and any other MCP client. Stack: Python, MCP, FastAPI, PostgreSQL. Result: 91% of never-seen names resolved first try; Live: docsforge.vercel.app.
